headline: Live Anywhere. Share Everywhere.
subheadline: Europe's first home-sharing community for EU/EEA citizens — no rent, with excess utility coverage included.
how_it_works_desc: 3 simple steps — no rent, no complicated contracts.
list_desc: Verify your identity, add your home, and open availability (3-month module, you can use 1 month).
book_desc: Book another verified home in another EU country. No rent. Excess utility coverage included.
live_anywhere_desc: Live, work, and explore. Reputation and gamification keep the community fair and trustworthy.
base_stay: Base stay of 3 months (you can use 1 month)
fund_desc: Coverage for excessive utility consumption for host peace of mind.
fund_card1_desc: No add-ons: each subscription contributes to the community fund that covers excess utilities.
fund_card2_desc: Covers excess utility consumption (water, electricity, gas) above normal usage, with minimum €30 difference required. Proof required with 6 previous months' bills.
fund_card3_desc: Annual reports on fund inflows and outflows. The community decides future limits.
faq1_a: Maintain a ≥ 1:1 ratio between months made available and used (12-month rolling window).
faq2_q: Who pays the bills (water, electricity, gas)?
faq2_a: Each host keeps paying utilities of their own house — the costs should be more or less the same. Guests enjoy utilities under Fair Use policy (responsible consumption). Our Community Fund covers genuine excess consumption above €30 (with proof). Guests who abuse utilities face reputation penalties and potential suspension. Most stays have zero issues — our community is respectful.
faq3_q: What if the host cancels or doesn't open the door?
faq3_a: In case of host cancellation or no-show, the guest's usage month is immediately returned to their balance and they are welcome to find another solution from our pool of available homes. EU HomePass, being a platform where people list and share their houses, does not act as a hospitality service and therefore has no responsibilities in no-shows or cancellations. The host's reputation will be negatively impacted, and repeated cancellations lead to penalties. In severe cases, hosts may lose platform access entirely.
faq4_q: What documents are accepted as proof of residence?
faq4_a: Lease agreement, host declaration, utility bill (≤ 3 months), or municipal certificate.
disclaimer_text: EU HomePass is a community platform that facilitates temporary home exchange between EU/EEA citizens. EU HomePass does not provide direct accommodation and is not responsible for cancellations or access failures.
account_created: Account created (demo). Integrate your auth flow (Supabase/Auth0) here.
